headline: Swedish Gripen pilot authorized by NATO to target missile over Poland
summary: A Swedish JAS 39 Gripen pilot received NATO authorization to shoot down a suspected Russian cruise missile over Poland, but held fire due to severe weather conditions.
why: NATO air defense patrols monitor eastern European airspace against illegal missile incursions.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Active NATO air defense engagements underscore elevated regional security alerts.
